instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "List the comparisons and the all-of and any-of groups a rule can use, for one kind of field or every kind", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:list-comparisons and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Answers each comparison's id, its label, what it takes (nothing, one value, a list of values, words, text, a day or a range) and the field kinds that offer it, the group combinators, and the field kinds known.
